title: Algebraic Stories — Hilbert series of other classes of ideals
exact_target: Does taking powers of generic forms of degree at least two preserve the Hilbert series of fully generic generators of the resulting degree?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1500011 (AMR-014-0011). CC BY 4.0.
R. Fröberg, S. Lundqvist, A. Oneto and B. Shapiro, \emph{Algebraic Stories from One and from the Other Pockets}, arXiv:1801.01692 (2018), §2.2, Conjecture 2.4.
